tests_reading_method: Measured on 2026-09-30 by running each of the 543 files tests/*.test.js on its own (node --test <file>, eight at a time) with a read-tracing preload loaded through NODE_OPTIONS, so child processes inherit it. The preload, kept in the session scratch directory and never committed, wrapped fs.readFileSync, fs.readFile, fs.promises.readFile, fs.openSync, fs.open, fs.promises.open, fs.createReadStream and the copy calls (fs.copyFileSync, fs.copyFile, fs.cpSync, fs.cp and their promise forms), and logged each path under agents/ or skills/ per test file, paths only. The log was then inverted. A read through a call the preload did not wrap (a worker thread, a native addon, a spawned non-Node program) would be missed. tests/agent-and-skill-improvement-record.test.js was not traced: it did not yet pass while the inventory was being measured, and it reads every inventoried file by construction. Under the preload 3 test files failed: tests/lint.test.js, tests/readme-numbers.test.js, tests/sessionstart-coverage.test.js. tests/sessionstart-coverage.test.js fails only while the preload is loaded (a tracing artefact, as the previous slice recorded); tests/lint.test.js and tests/readme-numbers.test.js failed because the new record test existed but was not yet finished and the documented test-file count had not yet been synced; their reads were logged all the same. None of the three is a failure of the suite; the full gate settles that.
